assessment_methods.method: Group Work (TG) memory delivery and group defense

assessment_rules: For ordinary examination, the theoretical block (TEO = (T1+T2+T3)/3) requires an average of 5. The practical block (PRAC = 0.75 * (PP1+PP2+TPI)/3 + 0.25 * TG) requires a minimum grade of 5 for PRAC, TPI, and TG. Additionally, a minimum of 75% attendance to laboratory sessions is required. If all minimums are met, the final grade is calculated as 0.60 * TEO + 0.40 * PRAC; otherwise, it is the minimum between the calculated grade and 4.0. For extraordinary examination, parts with a grade >=5 from the ordinary examination are retained. Theoretical part (ET) is a written exam on all theoretical content (minimum 5.0). Practical part includes improved group work memory and individual defense (TG, minimum 5.0), improved individual tasks (TPI, minimum 5.0), and a practical exam on all practices (EP, minimum 5.0). If all minimums are met, the final grade is 0.60 * ET + 0.40 * (0.25 * TG + 0.25 * TPI + 0.50 * EP); otherwise, it is the minimum between the calculated grade and 4.0. Differentiated evaluation replaces in-course theoretical controls and group tutorial lab follow-up with global tests (ET, TPI, EP), with a final grade of 0.60*ET + 0.20*TPI + 0.20*EP if all minimums are met, or the minimum between 4.0 and the formula otherwise.
